channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: Sources: OpenAI nears an up to $30B round led by investors from the UAE and Coatue at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, as an "opportunistic" bridge ahead of an IPO
item.description: OpenAI is nearing a round of up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, led by UAE investors and Coatue. It is meant to bridge the company to a 2027 IPO. Why it matters: Shows how investors value the AI giant ahead of its potential IPO, with UAE investors leading the round.

item.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: Anthropic is donating its Agent Skills open standard to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. Anthropic says 70+ platforms have already integrated it. Why it matters: Puts a shared standard for giving AI agents specialized workflows under neutral, community-driven governance.

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end sharply lower as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff
item.description: AI generated NEW YORK - US stocks tumbled on Oct 22 and the Nasdaq posted its steepest daily drop since June as a batch of high-profile earnings reports ignited fresh fears about the AI spending race. Why it matters: Shows how sensitive markets are to AI spending; the chip index has lost about a quarter since its June record.

item.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
item.description: Password manager 1Password launched 1Password for Agents, which lets AI agents log into users' personal accounts without the agent ever having access to their credentials. A unique digital key is sent to 1Password to confirm the agent's identity. Why it matters: Addresses growing concern over AI agents holding access to personal accounts; 1Password reports $500M in ARR.

item.title: Arista patches new VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
item.description: Arista released patches for an actively exploited SQL injection zero-day in VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem deployments. Anyone able to log in, even with a read-only customer account, can gain operator privileges. Why it matters: Attacks are already underway against a critical-severity flaw in a central SD-WAN management system, tracked as CVE-2026-114625.

item.title: Someone hacked the Switch 2 by using an old game and AI
item.description: A modder jailbroke the Nintendo Switch 2 using a software-only, tethered exploit that OpenAI's Codex helped create.

item.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
item.description: Microsoft says China-aligned hackers breached ConnectWise's cloud backup service and used AI agents to hack into about 2,250 organizations.

item.title: Sources: SoftBank's SB Energy is considering going public as soon as December or waiting until 2027, as it closely watches Anthropic's IPO, expected in November
item.description: SoftBank's SB Energy is considering an IPO as soon as December or waiting until 2027, while watching Anthropic's IPO expected in November.

item.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
item.description: Canva launched Canva Craft, its first AI image model, which plans a design before generating the image and produces images up to 2K resolution.

item.title: Rivian buys world model startup to accelerate self-driving ambitions
item.description: Rivian acquired Third Dimension, a UK startup using AI to turn images and videos into 3D worlds for self-driving development.

item.title: How to Read Data into GPU Memory in Python with NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage
item.description: This guide shows how to use NVIDIA KvikIO, a Python library, to read data directly into GPU memory with GPUDirect Storage.

item.title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
item.description: Microsoft and Hugging Face describe ThinkingBox-Training, which uses database checks as rewards, lifting one model's average task success from 51.70% to 60.78%.

item.title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
item.description: OpenShell is a runtime that runs AI agents in isolated sandboxes, enforcing declared policies on file access, system calls, and network connections.

item.title: Deploy AI in a HIPAA-eligible environment with Amazon Quick
item.description: A post explains that Amazon Quick is HIPAA-eligible but eligibility is not compliance, and outlines how to deploy AI agents in healthcare settings.

item.title: Stream low-latency speech from AI agents using Kokoro TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI
item.description: A post shows how to stream each agent sentence to a Kokoro-82M speech model on SageMaker AI, so audio starts before the reply is done.

item.title: Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles — Erik Bernhardsson, Modal CEO
item.description: In an interview, Modal's CEO explains the economics of elastic GPU compute, noting demand rarely matches the fixed capacity contracts used to buy it.

item.title: AI and the Enclosure of the Scientific Commons
item.description: This paper argues that AI can enable a previously infeasible enclosure of the scientific literature, which it calls an information commons.

item.title: CVE-2026-115384 (CVSS 9.4): Wasmtime 39.0.0 before 48.0.4 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.2 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability that allows malici
item.description: Wasmtime 39.0.0 to before 48.0.4, and 49.0.0 to before 49.0.2, have a stack overflow that can crash the host or let attackers escape the sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2026-109618 (CVSS 9.2): PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some co
item.description: PHP's out-of-memory handling can leave request memory uninitialized, and cleanup may read it, leading to remote code execution (CVE-2026-109618).

item.title: Siemens WinCC
item.description: Siemens SIMATIC WinCC has a flaw letting authenticated database users run commands on the host (CVE-2026-59241); fixed versions are out for several products.

item.title: eMudhra says it will exit the SSL/TLS certificate business, 1% of its revenue, after its TLS certificates with private keys of just 3 to 8 bits were compromised
item.description: eMudhra, an Indian certificate authority, will exit global SSL/TLS certificates after a researcher recovered private keys for eight of its intermediate CA certificates.

item.title: ThreatsDay: AI Secrets Leak, PingCAP Source Theft, Signal Hang-Up Flaw, Laravel Auth Bypass + 21 More
item.description: A weekly roundup of security news, including PHP and GitLab RCE flaws, a hacked LiteLLM release, and hijacked Tor relays.

item.title: Jared Kushner Hacked Phone Reveals Secret Negotiations, Millions in Transactions
item.description: A report says the Dutch government hacked Jared Kushner's phone and monitored him accessing a Dubai bank account holding hundreds of millions of dollars.

item.title: I had plans for that second
item.description: This Threat Source newsletter covers Earth's rotation speeding up and the leap second's abolition, alongside critical PHP vulnerabilities.

item.title: Anthropic IPO to drive blockbuster gains for Iconiq, Spark, GIC
item.description: Anthropic's imminent public listing is expected to bring large gains to early backers, including investment firm Iconiq, whose stake is worth about US$17 billion.

item.title: SK Hynix drops US IPO plan for Solidigm, newspaper reports
item.description: SK Hynix has reportedly dropped plans for a US IPO of its Solidigm flash memory subsidiary, according to a Korean newspaper citing unnamed sources.

item.title: Moderna shares plunge after cancer vaccine data leaks — despite positive results
item.description: Moderna shares fell up to 25% after partial data leaked, despite full results showing melanoma vaccine with Keytruda cut recurrence or death risk by 42%.

item.title: Korean fashion platform Musinsa deepens ties with Japan's Zozo ahead of IPO
Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy
item.description: The Winklevoss-backed Digital Freedom Fund spent over $81,000 on direct mail supporting Republican Ken Paxton in the Texas Senate race, per an FEC filing.

item.title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
item.description: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier, broadening its focus to AI and emerging tech while still investing in blockchain.

item.title: Palantir chief: Europe must ‘accept some dependency’ on US tech
item.description: European countries must accept that some dependence on American technology is inevitable, according to Palantir’s UK and Europe chief, as governments increasingly look to domestic alternatives to US suppliers.

item.title: Italian startups are growing up: bigger early-stage rounds and more late-stage money, data shows
item.description: It’s been an unconventional but positive year for Italian startups so far in 2026.

item.title: Fall 2026 earnings watch
item.description: Every company is suddenly an AI company. We’ve been promised robots — again.

item.title: The Browser Company says it will shut down its Arc browser on December 22, launched in 2023, shifting attention to its AI-focused Dia browser, launched in 2025
item.description: The Browser Company plans to “sunset” its Arc browser on December 22nd, according to a post on the Arc website.

item.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
item.description: Design platform Canva released its first image generation model, called Canva Craft, developed by its research team to compete with same-category models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, and Meta.

item.title: Chicago-based Formic, which provides robots-as-a-service automation to manufacturers, raised $50M, including a $40M Series B and $10M in asset-backed financing
item.description: Formic, a physical AI commercialization platform, raised $50 million in financing, CEO Saman Farid tells Axios exclusively.

item.title: TSH Resources reports 274 hot spots within estate boundaries after SGX queries over haze
item.description: TSH Resources reported 274 hot spots within its Indonesian estate boundaries from Jan 1 to Oct 21, all in community enclaves outside its operational areas.

item.title: Haze eases in Singapore as residents wake up to improved air quality
item.description: Air quality across Singapore reached the good to moderate range early on Oct 23, after a period of unhealthy air since Oct 5.

item.title: 'We don't really want to cancel': Singaporeans weigh France travel plans amid violent protests
item.description: Singaporean travellers are weighing trips to France amid violent protests over rising living costs and declining public services.

item.title: AI-related demand powers prices, rents of Singapore industrial space in third quarter of 2026
item.description: JTC's industrial rental index rose 0.5% in Q3 as AI-related demand kept Singapore industrial rents and prices firm, though occupancy eased to 88.9%.

item.title: Alpine skiing-Pinheiro Braathen embraces freedom after taking unconventional path to Olympic gold
item.description: Olympic champion Lucas Pinheiro Braathen says his independent team gives him control over his sporting and commercial decisions after returning to skiing for Brazil.

item.title: CVE-2026-76268 | Splunk Enterprise Patroni REST API Missing Authentication Vulnerability
item.description: CVE-2026-76268 is a critical Splunk Enterprise flaw in the Patroni REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers with network access execute operating-system commands; CVSS 9.8.

item.title: SoFi targets idle crypto cash with interest-bearing tokenized deposit
item.description: SoFi launched a tokenized deposit product that lets customers earn interest on cash set aside for crypto purchases. The deposits are FDIC-insured up to $250,000 per depositor. Why it matters: Banks are offering regulated, interest-bearing alternatives as the GENIUS Act bars stablecoin interest.

item.title: Your Next Customer Might Be An Agent. Here’s How To Build Your Brand For Both Humans And AI.
item.description: AI agents increasingly recommend and purchase products, so brands must appeal to both machines and humans. Guest author Toby Coulthard suggests startups document their voice, write clear product descriptions, and check how AI summarizes their messaging. Why it matters: AI agents often make purchase decisions before a human sees the product page.

item.title: Another Domestic Decision Model Released! Accuracy Surpasses Microsoft and Jev Decision Models
item.description: Ant Digital Technologies released LingDT-Decision-1.0, a decision model built for enterprises' high-frequency judgment tasks. The source claims its accuracy surpasses Microsoft and JEV models on 23 open-source benchmarks. Why it matters: Relevant to readers following enterprise AI models; the source gives few technical details.

item.title: The AI IPO Wave Is The Dot-Com Bubble’s Evil Twin. Anthropic’s Delay Just Proved It.
item.description: In a guest article, Airrived CEO Anurag Gurtu argues that Anthropic's rapid revenue growth does not justify its proposed $2 trillion IPO valuation. He cites infrastructure commitments, safety concerns, customer concentration and competition from cheaper open-weight models. Why it matters: Bears on AI IPO valuations and markets; the piece argues lasting value comes from proprietary data and measurable outcomes.

item.title: Firms here should ‘act now’ to fix critical PHP vulnerabilities: Singapore’s cybersecurity chief
item.description: Singapore's cybersecurity chief Gwenda Fong urged organisations to act now on two critical PHP vulnerabilities, which AI tools uncovered after years undetected. PHP developers released fixes on Oct 21. Why it matters: Small firms relying on outside IT vendors or hosts may not realise their systems are affected.

item.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
item.description: Symantec researchers found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models to run attacks, steal databases and install cryptominers without human input.

item.title: Eiliko maker says it’s hiring an ‘independent security firm’ after Verge report on its insecure robots
item.description: Eiliko's maker says it is hiring an independent security firm after a Verge report found its AI robot charm insecure.

item.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
item.description: Anthropic released a preview of Claude Duet, a proactive agent built on Claude Opus 5.5 that asks approval before sensitive actions like payments.

item.title: SAP clients increasingly worry about AI models' origin, CFO says
item.description: SAP's finance chief says customers increasingly ask where the AI in their business software was built, amid export controls and European sovereignty debate.

item.title: Claude did not invent scorpion antivenom
item.description: Citrini Research tested whether an unreleased Claude could make scorpion antivenom; it produced only promising starting points, not a drug.

item.title: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models
item.description: IBM's Granite Timeseries Ensemble combines four Granite forecasting models into one recipe that returns median and quantile forecasts without retraining or fitted ensemble weights.

item.title: [AINews] OpenAI’s Patch the Planet program is 1 of 2 parties to discover PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in core PHP affecting 70% of the web, using GPT-5.6 Sol; coordinated response over 2 months
item.description: Calif researcher Ryan Austin and Wiz independently found core PHP vulnerabilities, in a coordinated response lasting about two months.

item.title: OpenAI CLI
item.description: The official CLI for the OpenAI REST API, installable with Homebrew or Go 1.26 or later.

item.title: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
item.description: A 360M-parameter language model fine-tuned to imitate a terminal, predicting screen changes from keypresses with no real shell behind it.

item.title: ‘Jensen’s nightmare’: Huawei, DeepSeek narrow AI chip ecosystem gap with Nvidia: report
item.description: A SemiAnalysis report says DeepSeek's work with Huawei's Ascend 950PR chips is narrowing the gap with Nvidia's chip ecosystem.

item.description: CVE-2026-42025 (CVSS 9.1) describes stack buffer overflows in the TOTOLINK X2000R's boa formIpv6Setup dhcp_dns functionality, allowing arbitrary code execution via an authenticated HTTP request.
